author: Atdit
body:
Hello dear Senior Mods of the Avicus network! Here's my Teamspeak appeal:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════
Primary questions
═════════════════════════════════════════════════

Your minecraft username: AtditC/Atdit
The reason you were temp-banned/banned: "Banned on the Avicus Network" / "MicSpam" (BUT I CAN EXPLAIN THIS: I use macros on my keyboard for CS:GO messages and stuff, as I once was going to the toilet, I accidentally turned the autoclick-macro (I don't use it in Minecraft, trust me :D) on and the pointer was at the mute-button... It's like 20 cps. I think it explains all. Sorry for that!...
Why you should be unbanned from the server.: I don't want to be unbanned from the gameserver yet. To be honest, I will try my luck in a few months. But I really want to be unbanned from the Aviucs-Teamspeakserver. It's like 7-8 months ago, when I was banned. And I never teamspeak-ban-evaded with my desktop-pc. I still have the same IP I guess... Anyways, I don't have any evidence of a wrong infraction, so I'm only asking you, can I be unbanned? I waited a pretty long time and I miss all teamspeak buddies :/


═════════════════════════════════════════════════
Other Questions
═════════════════════════════════════════════════

Was my temp-ban or ban really false?: Yes and no, because for me, it doesn't make sense to be unbanned on the teamspeakserver when you ban evaded many times in-game. It's like two different servers.
Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false?: No
Have I waited long enough to be un-banned?: I think 7 months are enough? Aren't they? I'd wait even more...
Have I been caught ban evading?: Yep. Many times. But only in-game.
Have I appealed a ban before?: Only DDoS bans. And it took ages to get myself unbanned!

═════════════════════════════════════════════════
If I'd really get unbanned, here are my teamspeak identities:

AtDiT: b8MxRh9mXtGFqnR2EppDDyYUiEs=
Security level: 38
IP-adress: 84.227.117.5 (Switzerland)

MusicBot/AtditBot (This one was banned for the same reason): gUlcsm8z3mM/7UVA+NfuBI1aXZY=
Security level: about 35-38
IP-adress: 84.200.24.244 (Germany)

If I won't be unbanned, please tell me what to do. I'm at a really bad point :I
